author: Ankit
problem: Read one of these AtCoder usernames and print its rating: tourist 3858, ksun48 3679, Benq 3658, Um_nik 3648, apiad 3638, Stonefeang 3630, ecnerwala 3613, mnbvmar 3555, newbiedmy 3516, semiexp 3481.
bug_description: Checks for the name 'marinara' instead of 'mnbvmar', so mnbvmar prints nothing.

comments.accurate: Prints the rating of one of the top-10 AtCoder players, looked up by username
comments.wrong_behavior: Exact, case-sensitive match on the username; a name not in the table prints nothing
comments.wrong_location: Rating table verified against the ranking; check the input for trailing spaces
